ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for those secondary level students registered in the sciences, math, social studies, and history certification programs. NOTE: You are required to take this section (SPED 205, Section B, CRN 53210) Which meets during the first five weeks of the term (August 24 to October 3). Then you will need to register for SPED 405, Section S2, CRN 35776, which will meet during the final ten weeks of the semester (October 4 to December 9).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Secondary & Continuing Educ or Physics or Teaching of Biological Science or Teaching of Chemistry or Speech Communication or Biology or Chemistry or Geology or History or Teaching of Computer Science or Mathematics major(s).
